subject: POC prompt dataset collection & evaluation plan - AcmeCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam O'Neill <sam.oneill@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC next steps & data collection (post-call recap)

Hi Sam — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC so we can get your eval team started this week:

1) Success criteria (we discussed tentatively on the call):
- 95% intent classification accuracy on your 10k sample set OR a 40% reduction in time-to-resolution for triaged customer messages (your preference)
- Response latency under 350ms p50 for interactive use-cases
- Cost target: below $0.002/token on average for steady-state traffic

2) Data for prompt/eval set collection (what we need from Acme):
- 500–1,000 representative prompts for each major intent (sample CSV is fine)
- 1–2 weeks of anonymized production logs for error/edge-case coverage (redacted JSON is ok)
- A small list (~50) of high-priority example prompts where human judgment is essential

3) Evaluation plan & ownership:
- You: provide prompt CSV and redacted logs by Fri Aug 30 (Nina to own)
- Us: build prompt set, generate model outputs, run automatic evals + 100 human-label spot checks
- Rishi: will own model config and run initial hyperparameters for the trial
- Laura: will own success criteria tracking and run demos for your stakeholders

4) Timeline (proposed) — adjustable based on data delivery:
- Week 0 (data receive): ingest & sanitization
- Week 1: baseline runs + evaluation rubric setup
- Week 2: iterative tuning + demo to your team

Can you confirm Nina will own delivering the prompt CSV and redacted logs, and whether the 95% accuracy OR 40% triage improvement is your primary success metric? Once confirmed, we’ll share a small intake form and secure S3 upload link (or Drive folder) for data transfer.

Attachments: sample_prompt_template.csv (CSV, 4 KB)

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Sam O'Neill <sam.oneill@acme-corp.com>

Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC next steps & data collection (post-call recap)

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. Quick answers: we prefer the 40% reduction in time-to-resolution as the primary success metric (that maps better to our CS goals).

Nina will own data delivery. She’s out on Thursday but back Monday; can she send the CSV + a small redacted logs bundle by EOD Monday Aug 2? If possible we’d like to include 2 weeks of chat logs and one week of email triage logs.

Couple of clarification items for Rishi:
- For the log redaction, please confirm you’re okay with removing PII and replacing IDs with stable pseudonyms (that’s what our infra team will do).
- Are there any specific format constraints for the prompt CSV beyond the sample template?

I’ll attach a tiny sample of our typical prompts so you have a preview (attachment: acme_prompts_sample.csv).

Cheers,
Sam
Head of CS, AcmeCorp

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Sam O'Neill <sam.oneill@acme-corp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC next steps & data collection (post-call recap)

Hi Sam / Nina when you’re back — quick technical notes so the data handoff is smooth:

1) Redaction: Pseudonymization is perfect; please ensure timestamps remain (relative time OK) and remove any free-text PII (names, emails) from message bodies.

2) Prompt CSV: we only need 3 columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, intent_label (intent_label optional but helpful). CSV can be UTF-8 with LF line endings.

3) Logs: one JSON file per day is ideal. If you can’t split, a single compressed JSON is fine. File sizes up to 5GB ok via our S3 link.

4) Evaluation specifics: to measure time-to-resolution reduction we plan to: (a) run baseline model over historical logs to estimate automated triage rate, (b) run Redwood trial config, measure throughput and estimated triage improvement, (c) provide human-validation samples. We’ll share the rubric by Mon Aug 2.

If Nina can push the sample files by Aug 2 EOD we should hit the Week 0 ingestion window and be on track for the demo in Week 2.

Thanks — Rishi
Principal Inference Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@acme-corp.com>

Subject: Re: POC next steps & data collection (post-call recap)

Hi all — attaching the initial files per Marissa/Rishi request. I’ve redacted PII and pseudonymized IDs. Let me know if you need additional context columns.

Attachments:
- acme_prompts_sample.csv (CSV, 128 KB) — includes prompt_id, prompt_text, intent_label for ~750 samples across our top 6 intents.
- acme_prod_logs_redacted.json (JSON, 2.3 MB) — 10 days of chat + email triage logs, timestamps preserved, IDs pseudonymized.

We confirm Nina (me) is the owner for data delivery. We’re OK to use the S3 upload you provide; otherwise Drive link works. We’d prefer the trial to focus on the triage improvement metric.

Next steps for us: please send the intake form and S3 details. We’d like a short kickoff call after you ingest the data to walk through preliminary findings — Thu Aug 5 or Fri Aug 6 windows work for our team.

Thanks,
Nina Patel
